explication: MinHook is a Windows x86/x64 API-hooking library. A caller initializes the library, creates a disabled hook for a target and detour, then enables it; the returned trampoline lets the detour call the original function. Hook management also supports removing hooks, all-hooks operations, and queued enable/disable changes. Internally, hook management allocates executable buffers and builds trampolines; instruction decoding supports relocation. The graph follows documented API behavior and source-index references; implementation details beyond the supplied excerpts are not inferred.
